patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage: Kaspr leans data-enrichment, lead-management; RocketReach leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline.; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs RocketReach-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..

Limitations — Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms; RocketReach: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager.; Essentials is email-only; mobile/direct phones require Pro+..

Poor-fit cases: Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · RocketReach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager. · Avoid Kaspr if you actually need RocketReach's motion (B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
